extraFacts.fact: 12L14 and 12L15 are leaded free-machining low-carbon steels.
extraFacts.source: ASTM A108 / SAE J403 grade listings for 12L14 and 12L15

extraFacts.fact: NPTF (Dryseal) is standardised in ASME B1.20.3: a taper pipe thread cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread; NPT (ASME B1.20.1) seals with sealant.
extraFacts.source: ASME B1.20.3 and ASME B1.20.1 scopes

extraFacts.fact: SAE Code 61 is the standard-pressure four-bolt split-flange series; the flange head is sealed with an O-ring and held by a flange clamp.
extraFacts.source: SAE J518 / ISO 6162-1 four-bolt flange connections

extraFacts.fact: Sixteenths of an inch: hose and fitting dash sizes count sixteenths, so -4 is 1/4 inch, -6 is 3/8 inch, -8 is 1/2 inch, -12 is 3/4 inch and -16 is 1 inch.
extraFacts.source: SAE J514 / ISO 8434 dash size convention

extraFacts.fact: BSPP is a parallel pipe thread (ISO 228-1) that seals at a face, washer or O-ring; BSPT is a taper pipe thread (ISO 7-1, R thread) that seals on the thread.
